newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-OLYMPIC CHAMPION BARNES OUT OF WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-OLYMPIC CHAMPION BARNES OUT OF WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.

text.p: Olympic shot put champion Randy Barnes failed to qualify on Saturday for the world championships final after finishing 14th in the qualifying round.
American Barnes, the world record holder had a best put of 19.51 in his group which was headed by compatriot and defending champion John Godina.
Godina, who recorded 21.10 with his only attempt, finished second to Barnes at the Atlanta Olympics last year.
